decisionScope: Payment collection and payout feasibility only; not a judgment that the offer has demand or should be permanently abandoned.
falsifiableHypothesis: The existing Contra account can serve as a direct-customer collection rail only if a fresh owner-attested authenticated account observation proves wallet, identity, tax profile, Egypt SWIFT payout and intended payment-path readiness; until then, no route is COLLECTION_READY.

founder890Crossover.title: THE IDEA IMMUNE SYSTEM
founder890Crossover.literalBody: Revolutionary systems need protection against seductive nonsense. Every major idea faces adversarial falsification, alternative explanations, independent replication, economic reality, and physical constraints before receiving resources.
founder890Crossover.application: Keep provider policy, internal account reports, and legal conclusions separate; require counterexamples and retain HOLD until account and tax claims are falsifiable with direct evidence.

founder890Crossover.title: THE OUTCOME ECONOMY
founder890Crossover.literalBody: Shift economic organization away from paying mainly for activity or access toward verified beneficial outcomes where measurement permits.
founder890Crossover.application: Do not treat an invoice, usage event, model, or payout release as cleared profit; require bank credit and reconcile net contribution and customer acceptance.

ownerActions.evidence: Redacted written bank answer or owner-attested terms; no bank credentials, full account number, or payment sent.

ownerActions.costNote: Fee unknown; no paid engagement or filing is authorized. Stop before any nonzero spend.
